name: Spellfire Robes
summary: In the Undercity, Spellfire Robes mark a young Horde mage's passage toward mastery. Josef Gregorian finishes them after the apprentice brings rare components from across the realm.

sections.title: A Mage's Vestment
sections.body: In Lordaeron, you need more than ordinary cloth to channel and shield your growing magic. Josef Gregorian is a tailor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He makes magical garments from specialized materials gathered by promising Horde spellcasters. The final stitching marks your passage beyond basic incantations toward arcane and fire magic.

sections.title: Woven Power
sections.body: Josef Gregorian needs alchemical and arcane components to make robes that focus powerful magic. You gather the supplies through dangerous trials and bring them to his sanctum in the Undercity. There, Gregorian weaves them together. The robes mark your growing status and offer protection as an aspiring mage.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Spellfire Robes quest?
faq.answer: These robes complete an early rite of passage for Horde mages. After gathering the tailoring components, you receive specially enchanted robes from Josef Gregorian.
Josef Gregorian is a Forsaken tailor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He stitches the first proper class garments for newly minted mages sent to him by Anastasia Hartwell.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
aliases: where to turn in spellfire robes
faq.answer: You meet Josef Gregorian at his tailor shop in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.

faq.q: Why don't you have to leave to do another task for this quest?
faq.answer: You gathered the materials in the preceding assignment, Gathering Materials. Give the reagents to Josef, and he weaves the garment and hands you the finished robes.

faq.q: Can classes other than Mages obtain these robes?
faq.answer: No. Only mages allied with the Horde can receive these enchanted robes.

faq.q: What materials were required to make these robes?
faq.answer: The robes require rare supplies gathered earlier, including linen cloth and Dalaran mana gems taken from the Kirin Tor mages of Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As a Horde mage, you receive these robes as an early rite of passage. Their tailored cloth can withstand volatile fire and arcane energies.
As a Forsaken spellcaster in the Undercity, you carry on Dalaran-style arcane discipline. Your craft joins old magical traditions with your new existence in Lordaeron's ruins.
As a tailor, you can see how exotic reagents strengthen ordinary cloth against powerful magical currents.
